name: ldg-build-the-70-20-10-plan
description: Builds a plan that carries learning into the work of a role, with real assignments matched to each capability, coaching and peer learning tied to those assignments, only the formal pieces the assignments need, and an owner and a check-in date for each, with no percentage targets.
